scope: Groups 01 and 04 only: 32 native variant baselines and 20 ImageView/BackgroundPlate cases.

findings.result: All eight desktop Compact=True published variants have Primary and correctly violate Secondary-only.
BackgroundColor, Skeleton and Position variant switches lose independent target correspondence; all six intended violations unresolved.
All four intended violations detected; each also triggers the related visual baseline lock.
All three ImageView locks compliant per case. This proves the scoped allowed Segment setting, not whole-card readiness.
Graphic/Image target identity unresolved; three Image rules are human-review instead of not-applicable and Graphic presence is also unresolved.
Sixteen Background=False baselines produce five surface human-review evaluations each (selected-binding-unavailable), despite the proven root Background=False condition.
ViewportClass and CardPlacement absent in all live reports. Both checks become compliant in separate offline diagnostic replay with authored board context; this is not live acceptance.
findings.ui: Expand Ожидаемые параметры; explicitly choose Контекст: Ширина viewport and Контекст: Способ размещения for each selected case. Inputs reset on subject/mode/contract change.
